title: Decision-readiness - one row per requirement: the gate that blocks it and the number that would clear it
purpose: The landing page carries one row per requirement with the gate that blocks it and the number that would clear it, so every decision starts from the same table. This file holds that table plus a line-by-line audit of every bullet in the project brief. 'Number that clears' cells are MEASURABLE TARGETS agreed by design, not measured facts (flag F47); where a number is a measured fact it says so.

key.status: done | partial | blocked (the requirement register's status; partial/blocked name what is missing)
key.blocking_gate: the validation gate (G-1..G-18), register flag (F01..F47), open question (Q01..Q35) or owner decision (SG..) that actually stops progress - none for done rows
key.number_that_clears: the concrete, checkable number that moves the row to done
